capitalsolutionsgroup-capitalsolutionsgr.description: SECURITY CLEARANCE: TS/SCI with both Polygraphs is required POSITION: Senior Network Engineer REQUISITION: KEY-NE3-03.080626) LOCATION: Ft. Meade, Maryland JOB DESCRIPTION: Provides Network support that requires system level design, architecture or enterprise security and security boundaries, datacenter virtualization, CAN/MAN/LAN infrastructure packet capture software, TCP/IP protocol stack, routing/switching protocols, stateful firewalls, and L3/L4 access controls. • (U) Cisco IOS, CatOS, NxOS, filter and access control, Ciscoworks, TACACS+, ASA, FWSM, HP Openview, Cisco routers, Cisco Switches, F5/Cisco load balancers, Infiniband, Juniper, FiberChannel (FC) SAN, and VPN (IPSEC) • (U) Physical installation and configuration and troubleshooting of network routers, switches, load balancers and security devices. • (U) Strong knowledge of TCP/IP protocol stack and routing and switching protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of stateful firewalls, and L3 access controls. • (U) Working knowledge of Atlassian Tool Suite. • (U) Able to support on-call requirements. • (U) Able to work in live call environment and utilize remedy and/or other ticketing system to track tasking. • (U) Virtualization products; VMWare and Solaris containers. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9f44c5e1-47a7-.title: US Payroll Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9f44c5e1-47a7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a US Payroll Specialist based in United States. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced payroll professional supporting accurate, timely, and compliant US payroll operations. You will manage full-cycle payroll activities across multiple jurisdictions while ensuring strong data integrity and regulatory compliance. The role combines hands-on payroll processing with reporting, audits, tax support, employee service, and process improvement. You’ll work closely with employees, managers, internal teams, and leadership to resolve payroll questions and maintain a positive employee experience. The position also offers exposure to SOX controls, payroll systems, timekeeping, garnishments, and complex off-cycle payments. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, confidentiality, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. It is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a growing organization while helping strengthen reliable and efficient payroll operations. Manage full-cycle US payroll processing for a multi-jurisdictional employee population, including entering, auditing, reviewing, correcting, and transmitting payroll data accurately and on schedule. Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc payroll reports covering compensation, taxes, garnishments, deductions, earnings registers, payroll files, and related information. Process on-cycle and off-cycle payments, including final pay, commissions, stock-related payments, and other supplemental compensation. Prepare annual W-2 forms and complete required electronic payroll filings while maintaining well-organized and audit-ready records. Research, analyze, and resolve federal, state, and local payroll tax issues and support compliance with applicable wage and hour requirements. Respond to payroll questions from employees and managers, investigate discrepancies, and provide clear and timely resolutions. Conduct payroll data audits, identify inconsistencies, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain accurate employee and payroll records. Support SOX controls by following established procedures and maintaining documentation that demonstrates payroll accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage payroll inputs and timekeeping data, including time punches, scheduling information, and related system issues. Serve as a resource for timekeeping and scheduling systems by troubleshooting issues and providing process guidance. Process third-party payroll matters such as garnishments, levies, bankruptcies, and child support wage assignments. Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that increase payroll efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and employee service. Requirements: 5+ years of experience processing full-cycle US payroll for 500+ employees, including experience with multi-state or multi-jurisdictional payroll. 1+ year of Workday Payroll experience preferred; alternatively, 2+ years of experience with another US payroll platform. Strong working knowledge of federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations, including overtime requirements and payroll tax obligations. Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including formulas, data validation, reconciliations, reporting, and payroll-related analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the attention to detail needed to identify discrepancies and resolve issues accurately with minimal supervision. Demonstrated ability to understand, document, and improve payroll-related business processes. Experience supporting global and/or US-based business teams and collaborating effectively across functions. High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee, compensation, and payroll information. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll matter

southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:b19f556.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:b19f556.description: ABOUT CENTARI At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It's why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. Today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them. Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can. The most demanding transactional practices in the world already build on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at greater scale, and we're going after all of it. We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition. For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, AI to join our product team. You'll be a key player in designing Centari's core AI technology, working alongside engineers who share a bias for action. As one team, you'll write code, shape the product, interact with customers, and drive initiatives from concept to completion. Our systems are built with Go and React/TypeScript, leveraging cutting-edge LLM technologies across infrastructure, search, and persistence layers. If you're passionate about building impactful LLM applications and thrive on owning complex challenges, we want to hear from you. Applicant needs to be based in NYC area RESPONSIBILITIES: - Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions, focusing on LLM technologies. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement product features and improvements. - Contribute to the design of robust, scalable, and maintainable systems. - Interact with customers to gather feedback and ensure alignment with their needs. - Own the full development lifecycle of AI features, from ideation to deployment. REQUIREMENTS - Fluent with the latest AI technologies. Understanding of LLMs and agent-related technologies. - 5 years of experience working with production software - Proven ability to work with cutting-edge technology and eagerness to learn new skills. - Willingness to roll up sleeves and get things done - our engineers are comfortable switching between different technical domains as needed. - Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. NICE TO HAVE - Golang and/or Python expertise - Experience in a startup environment. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive salary and meaningful equity - Comprehensive health coverage (Centari covers 100% of employee premiums) - Dental and vision (Centari covers 75% of employee premiums) - 401(k) with employer match up to 4% - Lunch covered for in-office team - Flexible PTO
